newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil June 21-July 20 IGP-M index up 0.09 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil June 21-July 20 IGP-M index up 0.09 pct.

text.p: Brazilian inflation as measured by the IGP-M inflation index rose 0.09 percent between June 21 and July 20, compared with a 0.74 percent rise between May 21 and June 20, the Getulio Vargas Foundation (FGV) said.
The IGP-M is composed of three other economic indicators.

They are the IPA wholesale price index, which fell 0.28 percent in the period, the IPC consumer price index, which rose 0.42 percent in the period, and the INCC national index of construction costs, which gained 0.94 percent.
The IPA has a 60 percent weighting, the IPC a 30 percent weighting and the INCC 10 percent, the FGV said.
The IGP-M index, which measures inflation over 10-day intervals, is published by the independent research institute Fundacao Getulio Vargas (FGV).
((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
